title: [ML] fixes categorize_text parameter validation to be parse order independent

timeline.message: [ML] fixes categorize_text parameter validation to be parse order independent
timeline.author: Benjamin Trent

timeline.body:
Depending on how the input is parsed, we may not validate that the categorization_analyzer isn't set when the filters are present.

This commit addresses this bug.

closes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/82629
Shouldn't we be checking against the filters?

reply.body: The `filters` create an analyzer config, we don't store them.
